templates.why_chosen: Star-rated fast/slow-path variant: instead of two boxed planes, bold red Slow-Path and green Fast-Path bars sit beneath the shared Linux Driver, so color alone, not dashing, separates control-path IPC calls from the data-path IRQ.
templates.what_to_learn: When two paths share the same component, skip separate plane boxes and instead run a colored bar (red control, green data) directly under the shared box, with circled numbers 1-4 tracing the single request across both paths.
